name: Banana Bread
description: Moist loaf made with very ripe bananas.
steps: Heat the oven to 175 °C and line a loaf tin.
Mash the bananas and mix in the melted butter, sugar and eggs.
Fold in the flour, baking soda and salt until just combined.
Bake for 55–60 minutes until a skewer comes out clean, then cool before slicing.
